name: dailyos/metadata-proposal-drawer
title: Metadata Proposal Drawer
description: Expanded drawer for MetadataProposals (DOS-328 / W2 §5.6). Renders typed proposed value, target field, evidence summary, trust band, freshness caveat, display-safe provenance, plus accept/dismiss/edit affordances that emit FeedbackAction via record_claim_feedback (ADR-0123). Inserter-global per ADR-0129 §2 (no parent); composes inside any entity-detail outer block via usesContext envelopeHandle.
